name: Raspberry Vinegar
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put a quart of ripe red raspberries in a bowl
Pour on them a quart of strong well flavoured vinegar
Put this liquid on another quart of fresh raspberries
When this last is prepared, make it very sweet with pounded loaf sugar

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put a quart of ripe red raspberries in a bowl
2. Pour on them a quart of strong well flavoured vinegar
3. Let them stand twenty-four hours
4. Strain them through a bag
5. Put this liquid on another quart of fresh raspberries
6. Strain in the same manner
7. Then on a third quart
8. When this last is prepared, make it very sweet with pounded loaf sugar
9. Refine and bottle it
